# macOS Gotchas

> Known macOS patterns that cause silent failures or hard-to-debug errors.

## Entries

- [Unified log NDJSON includes completion and loss records](unified-log-ndjson-completion-and-loss.md): Recognize the completion summary and retain loss events before advancing monitoring cursors or accepting zero matches as healthy. HIGH.
- [Closing an infostealer incident does not undo the credential theft](infostealer-resolved-without-credential-rotation.md): Removing an AMOS-style LaunchAgent leaves every browser-saved password, cookie and keychain item stolen; rotate all of them from a clean device before resolving. HIGH.
